tools.name: mcp__postgresql__postgres_mcp_bulk_load_csv
tools.description:
Bulk‐load CSV file via COPY into a PostgreSQL table. Supports column mapping, optional SQL transforms, truncate-before-insert, and PK-based upsert. Use this to bulk-load CSV data into an existing table. The `path` must live under an approved bulk-load path (the current working directory by default, or one approved via `postgres-mcp allow-access-to-path <path>` / `POSTGRES_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS`). A directory grants recursive access to descendants; a file grants access only to that exact canonical file.
Example:
postgres_mcp_bulk_load_csv(
    connectionId='postgres-mcp/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/mydb',
    path='/path/to/file.csv',
    table='mytable',
    mapping={'col1': 'col1', 'col2': 'col2'},
    transforms={'col2': 'src.col2::int'},
    mode='upsert'
)

connectionId.description: Connection ID for the target PostgreSQL database

encoding.description: File encoding for reading the CSV file (default 'utf-8')

escape.description: Character used for escaping within CSV fields (default '\')

forceNotNull.description: Columns for which to force non-NULL interpretation of quoted null strings

forceNull.description: Columns for which to force NULL interpretation of unquoted null strings

header.description: Whether the CSV file has a header row (default True)

mapping.description: Required: source CSV column name → target table column name

mode.description:
Import strategy:
- 'insert': append new rows to the target table.
- 'truncate_insert': truncate the target table before inserting rows.
- 'upsert': insert new rows or update existing rows on primary key conflict.
(default 'insert')

null.description: String that represents a NULL value (default empty string)

path.description: Absolute path to the CSV file to load. Must live under an approved bulk-load path: the server reads CSVs only from the current working directory (by default), paths approved via `postgres-mcp allow-access-to-path <path>`, or those listed in `POSTGRES_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS`. A file path authorizes only that exact canonical file; a directory path authorizes descendants recursively.

quote.description: Character used for quoting CSV fields (default '"')

table.description: Target PostgreSQL table (optionally schema-qualified) that already exists

transforms.description: Optional: target column → SQL expression using src.<col> for casting/derivation

Returns a connection ID that is used to interact with the database with other tools from this postgres-mcp server. If a specific database is given and the connection fails, use postgres_mcp_list_databases against a connection to the default database to find the correct database name. The connection ID is a string formatted as 'postgres-mcp/{profile_id}[/{database name}]', where if no database name is present it's the default database for the profile.

database.description: Optional database name; if omitted, uses the profile's default database.You can list databases with a call to postgres_mcp_list_databases.

profileId.description: Profile ID. Ensure this is validated with a call to postgres_mcp_list_connection_profiles.

Use this tool to retrieve detailed context about the database objects (e.g. tables, indexes, functions, sequences, comments, ownership, default_privileges, fdw, or all) within a given schema or across all schemas.
Note: Always call this tool first to fetch the most up-to-date database schema context before executing any queries or modifications. This tool is strictly read-only and prevents duplicate or conflicting operations by ensuring you know the current state.

connectionId.description: Connection ID to use for fetching objects.

objectType.description: Database object type. Use 'all' (to fetch the complete database schema).

A directory grants recursive access to descendants; a file grants access only to that exact canonical file.

tools.name: mcp__postgresql__postgres_mcp_get_metrics_group
tools.description: Diagnose slow database and performance issues. USE THIS FIRST when users report slow queries, high CPU, or performance problems. Collects pre-correlated metrics by diagnostic group: core_health (CPU, memory, connections, storage), saturation (I/O pressure, disk, cache performance), throughput (transactions, tuples, workload volume), lock_contention (blocking sessions, deadlocks, lock waits). For Azure servers, includes Azure Monitor metrics automatically. Call postgres_mcp_get_server_capabilities first to see available groups. Max 5 groups per request, max 7 days for historical data.

connectionId.description: Connection ID from postgres_mcp_connect.

cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor from previous response. When a response has pagination.truncated=true, use pagination.cursor in the next request to continue fetching.

endTime.description: End time for historical Azure metrics in ISO format (e.g., '2025-01-30T21:00:00Z'). Required with startTime. Maximum 7 days range.

granularity.description: Time resolution for Azure metrics. Options: PT1M, PT5M, PT15M, PT30M, PT1H, PT6H, PT12H, P1D. Default: PT5M.

groups.description: List of diagnostic group names to collect. Call postgres_mcp_get_server_capabilities with the same connectionId and choose names from availableDiagnosticGroups. Groups cover server health, resource usage, query performance, maintenance, replication, and Azure-specific diagnostics; availability depends on server version, installed extensions, privileges, and Azure hosting. Maximum 5 groups per request.

outputFormat.description: Response format. 'json' returns structured JSON (default). 'csv' returns compact tabular format with key-value header and CSV data, optimized for token efficiency.

startTime.description: Start time for historical Azure metrics in ISO format (e.g., '2025-01-30T09:00:00Z'). Required with endTime for historical queries. Omit for current/point-in-time metrics.

tools.name: mcp__postgresql__postgres_mcp_get_server_capabilities
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST before diagnosing performance issues. Discovers what diagnostic tools are available for the connected server. Returns PostgreSQL version, Azure detection status, and available diagnostic groups for postgres_mcp_get_metrics_group. Each group includes its ID, description, and metric count. Shows why certain groups may be unavailable (missing extensions, version requirements, Azure-only features). Required step before using postgres_mcp_get_metrics_group for troubleshooting.

connectionId.description: Connection ID from postgres_mcp_connect to check capabilities for.

tools.name: mcp__postgresql__postgres_mcp_modify
tools.description:
Modify the database and/or schema by executing SQL statements including DDL (CREATE, ALTER, DROP) and DML (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE). Useful when designing schemas or inserting data. It must only be a single, spacious, well formatted query with line breaks and tabs. The statement will be presented to the user, so focus on readability. Returns the results of the statement execution, if any.
Note: Always fetch up-to-date database schema context using the postgres_mcp_db_context tool before proposing or executing modifications to avoid duplicates or conflicts. Ensure explicit user confirmation. On error, return clear and descriptive error messages to the user. NOTE: Use this tool when working with PostgreSQL databases INSTEAD of asking the user to run the psql CLI tool, unless otherwise explicitly asked to.

connectionId.description: Connection ID to use for the statement.

statement.description: The SQL statement to execute in order to modify the database. Formatted with line breaks and tabs, with comments.

tools.name: mcp__postgresql__postgres_mcp_query
tools.description: Run a formatted SQL query against a database. For performance diagnostics, prefer postgres_mcp_get_metrics_group instead. Requires a connection_id from the return value of postgres_mcp_connect. This query must not modify the database at all. Can include SELECT, SHOW, EXPLAIN etc. Do not include additional statements, e.g. SET search_path, in this query. It must only be a single, spacious, well formatted query with line breaks and tabs. The statement will be presented to the user, so focus on readability. Returns the results of the query. You MUST include a validation query to check the validity of EVERY literal value used in the SQL query. Do NOT skip this step. This tool is strictly read-only and executes a single statement only. Use EXPLAIN for performance or optimization analysis and include execution plan details. On error, return clear error messages to the user.

connectionId.description: Connection ID to use for the query.

maxResultRows.description: Optional cap on the number of rows returned in the response. When omitted, defaults to 10000. The full result set is fetched from the server; rows beyond this cap are truncated client-side and the response is prefixed with a banner noting the truncation.

query.description: The SQL query to execute, formatted in the style of a beautifier. Add comments to explain complex components.

validationQueries.description: A list of validation queries to use to ensure correctness. Use a validation query to check the validity of the literal values used in the SQL query. If the validation query fails, automatically fetch distinct values from the column being validated to identify potential alternatives, limiting to 50 entries. Use this data to adjust the query and retry without requiring user intervention. For example, if you use a literal value in a WHERE clause, use a validate_value_query like 'SELECT 1 FROM table WHERE value = ''literal_value''' and a fetch_distinct_values_query like 'SELECT DISTINCT column_name FROM table LIMIT 50'. Distinct values will be returned if the validation query fails. validation_queries can be empty if no validation is needed, but do NOT skip this step. All literal values must be validated.

items.description: A validation query to check literal values used in the SQL query.

Keep one edit under roughly 1 MiB; the whole document must stay under 6 MB (embedded images are base64 data URLs).

After cards appear, reply with AT MOST one short sentence.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

  Let me just exclude the first h1 unconditionally (it's the title) and any 附录*.

- 数字 keys: missing_keys = [] ✓ (all key values present now)
- num tokens 502 vs 313 (still fewer, explained)

- additions 117

Let me fix the h1 counting and also look at the generated report to check the 表格对照 section and the omitted list. Also the "gram_jaccard 0.224" needs honest interpretation — this is the most important caveat: only ~32% of the original's 4-grams appear. I should explain and also compute a *section-level* semantic coverage instead (e.g., per-chapter: does the 还原稿 chapter cover the original chapter's key terms?).

Let me add a per-chapter term-coverage metric: for each original chapter, compute the fraction of its top-N distinctive terms (2-4 grams appearing in that chapter) that appear in the corresponding 还原稿 chapter. That's a better coverage measure than global 4-gram Jaccard.

Given budget, let me add a simple per-chapter 2-gram coverage to show which chapters are well covered vs compressed. That's the actionable part.

Let me patch: per-chapter trigram coverage.

Then fix the report narrative accordingly and finalize.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path("build/a20_evaluate.py"); s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
# 修 h1 口径：第一个 h1 视为题名
old = '''_rh1 = [(lv, ti) for lv, ti in rh if lv == 1]
RC = [(lv, ti) for lv, ti in _rh1 if "可行性研究报告" not in ti and not ti.startswith("附录")]
RC_APP = [ti for lv, ti in _rh1 if ti.startswith("附录")]
RC_TITLE = [ti for lv, ti in _rh1 if "可行性研究报告" in ti]'''
new = '''_rh1 = [(lv, ti) for lv, ti in rh if lv == 1]
RC_TITLE = [_rh1[0][1]] if _rh1 else []          # 首个 h1 为报告题名，不计为章
RC_APP = [ti for lv, ti in _rh1 if ti.startswith("附录")]
RC = [(lv, ti) for lv, ti in _rh1[1:] if not ti.startswith("附录")]'''
assert s.count(old)==1; s=s.replace(old,new)

# 增：分章内容覆盖率（三元组）
add = '''
# ── 分章内容覆盖率（三元组）──────────────────────────────
def tgrams(t, n=3):
    t = re.sub(r"[\\s|#*>`\\-\\[\\]（）()【】「」，。；：、]", "", NUM.sub("N", t))
    return {t[i:i + n] for i in range(len(t) - n + 1)}


rc_ch = {norm_title(t): b for t, b in chapters(r)}
o_ch = {norm_title(t): b for t, b in chapters(o) if norm_title(t) in o_map}
cov_rows = []
for t, _ in OC:
    k = norm_title(t)
    a, b = tgrams(o_ch.get(k, "")), tgrams(rc_ch.get(k, ""))
    cov = (len(a & b) / len(a) * 100) if a else 0
    cov_rows.append((t, round(cov, 1)))
'''
s = s.replace("# ── 增量（纪律性内容）──", add + "\n# ── 增量（纪律性内容）──")

# 报告里插入分章覆盖率表并修正解释
old2 = '''A("- 压缩主要发生在**过程性记述**（学校简介中的赛事获奖、学术会议细节）"
  "与**纯清单**（设备表、财务三年全表）上；**论证链、测算链、造价链、依据链的篇幅基本保留**。")'''
new2 = '''A("- 压缩主要发生在**过程性记述**（学校简介中的赛事获奖、学术会议细节）"
  "与**纯清单**（设备表、财务三年全表）上；**论证链、测算链、造价链、依据链的篇幅基本保留**。")
A("")
A("### 3.1 分章内容覆盖率（三元组：原稿该章措辞在还原稿对应章的保留比例）")
A("")
A("| 章 | 覆盖率 | 章 | 覆盖率 |")
A("|----|--------|----|--------|")
_half = (len(cov_rows) + 1) // 2
for i in range(_half):
    a1, b1 = cov_rows[i]
    if i + _half < len(cov_rows):
        a2, b2 = cov_rows[i + _half]
        A(f"| {a1} | {b1}% | {a2} | {b2}% |")
    else:
        A(f"| {a1} | {b1}% | | |")
A("")
A("**如何看这张表**：覆盖率低 ≠ 内容缺失，它衡量的是**原文措辞的保留比例**。")
A("还原稿是**按图谱重新组织的**，不是复制原稿；论证与计算的段落被改写为"
  "「先说结论、再给依据与算式」的结构，原稿的行文措辞自然不会被逐句保留。")
A("真正需要警惕的是**覆盖率极低且篇幅也大幅压缩**的章——"
  "那才可能意味着内容丢失，而非改写。")'''
assert s.count(old2)==1; s=s.replace(old2,new2)
p.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8"); print("patched")

# 还原稿评估报告（与原稿对照）

> 评估对象：`交付物/报告/…可行性研究报告（还原稿）.docx`
> 基准：原稿（由原始 docx 确定性重推的正文文本）
> 口径：两者均按**去空白后的字符数**计（Word 字数口径），可复算。

---

## 一、总览

| 维度 | 原稿 | 还原稿 | 评价 |
|------|------|--------|------|
| 字符数（去空白） | 62025 | 50535 | 还原稿为原稿的 **81.5%** |
| 一级章 | 16 | 16 | 全覆盖（另有 3 个附录） |
| 二级/三级小节 | 135 | 113 | 覆盖 108/135 = 80% |
| 表格 | 31 | 28 | 还原稿 90% |
| 数字token（唯一） | 502 | 320 | 还原稿少 182 个——主因是未重出**设备明细表**与**近三年财务三表** |
| 与原稿 4-gram 重合 | — | — | **Jaccard 0.224；原稿内容被覆盖 32%** |

**一句话结论**：还原稿在**结构与事实层面基本等值**（16 章全覆盖、关键数值一致、表格达 90%），篇幅约为原稿的 81%；差异不在「丢了什么数」，而在于**还原稿把原稿中散落的口径问题变成了显式的待审项与复核结论**，同时**压缩了过程性记述与设备明细表**。

---

## 二、结构覆盖

### 2.1 一级章对照

| 原稿章 | 还原稿对应 | 状态 |
|--------|-----------|------|
| 总论 | 第一章　总论 | ✅ 对应 |
════════ 八 结论 ════════
## 八、结论与建议

### 8.1 评估结论

| 评估维度 | 结论 |
|----------|------|
| **结构完整性** | ✅ 一级章 16/16 全覆盖；小节覆盖 80% |
| **事实忠实度** | ✅ 关键取值零缺失；数值由图谱单一源注入，与原稿一致 |
| **篇幅** | △ 为原稿的 81%（压缩过程性记述与设备/财务明细） |
| **论证质量** | ✅ 优于原稿：断链处标注、保证缺失不代拟、结论章不引入新数 |
| **合规性提示** | ✅ 优于原稿：三条不合规、五条待审、两条待核查均显式呈现 |
| **表格** | △ 28/31，设备明细与三年财务表未重出 |
| **图件与目录** | ❌ 无 |

### 8.2 一句话判断

**还原稿可以作为「原稿的问题清单版」使用，但不能直接替代原稿报审。**

理由是：它在**事实与结构上与原稿等值**，并额外暴露了原稿隐藏的口径问题（这正是它比原稿更有用的地方）；但它按「可研深度」裁剪了设备明细表与过程性记述，且没有图件——这两项在报审时会被要求补齐。

### 8.3 若要用于报审，建议补齐三项

1. **图件**：向设计单位取项目位置图、总平面图、方案图、进度横道图、组织结构图，按图号插入；
2. **明细表**：把主要设备材料表、主要设备表、近三年财务三表恢复为完整表；

**关键取值保留 100%**：总建筑面积、总投资及四个分项、分类人数、人均指标、各类负荷与能耗指标——无一缺失。数字 token 少 182 个，来自**未重出的设备明细表与近三年财务三表**（规格型号/风量/功率/台数密集），属「按可研深度裁剪」，不是算错。

1. **结论章原本一个数都没有**（数字保留 0%）——我此前把纪律「不引入新数」误执行成了「不放任何数」。可研报告的结论章**本就该复述**总投资、总建筑面积、工期等头条指标（复述≠新增，仍走同一事实源）。已补 15.1 节「主要技术经济指标复述」，保留率 → **100%**。

**还原稿是「原稿的问题清单版」，还不能直接替代原稿报审。**

**关键取值保留 100%**：总建筑面积、总投资及四个分项、分类人数、人均指标、各类负荷与能耗指标——无一缺失。数字 token 少 182 个，来自**未重出的设备明细表与近三年财务三表**（规格型号/风量/功率/台数密集），属「按可研深度裁剪」，不是算错。

## 评估揪出并已修正的两处短板

1. **结论章原本一个数都没有**（数字保留 0%）——我此前把纪律「不引入新数」误执行成了「不放任何数」。可研报告的结论章**本就该复述**总投资、总建筑面积、工期等头条指标（复述≠新增，仍走同一事实源）。已补 15.1 节「主要技术经济指标复述」，保留率 → **100%**。
2. **选址章漏了气候参数**（年总辐射量、年降雨量、汛期雨量）——这些是暖通室外计算参数的输入。已补，该章保留率 42% → **67%**。

| 增量 | 处数 |
|---|---|
| ⚠ 待审冲突框 | 15 |

| 缺口留白 | 15 |

| 设计单位专属留白 | 4 |
| 口径与量纲提示 | 若干 |

这些不是废话——它们把原稿里**隐含的问题显式化**了：原稿同一个总建筑面积在不同章写得不一样，读者很难发现；原稿投资表分项之和对不上合计，表内不提示；原稿必要性章从「国家有战略」直接跳到「本校要建」，中间缺的推理许可没人指出。

## 遗漏（需人工确认）

| 原稿内容 | 还原稿处置 | 影响 |
|---|---|---|
| 表2-1 学科基本情况表（逐项） | 只给数量 | 中 |
| 表6-4 主要设备材料表、表6-11 主要设备表 | 声明「属设计单位深化范围」未列 | 中 |
| 表13-2/13-3/13-4 近三年财务三表 | 只留关键 6 项 | 中 |
| 无障碍设计条文级尺寸、表3-1 项目列表、过程性记述 | 概括或省略 | 低 |
| **全部图件**（位置图/总平面图/进度横道图等） | **无** | 高 |
| 目录页与页码 | 无（DOCX 有标题层级，可在 Word 一键生成） | 低 |

## 一句话结论

**还原稿是「原稿的问题清单版」，还不能直接替代原稿报审。**

它在**事实与结构上与原稿等值**（16 章全覆盖、关键取值零缺失、表格 90%），并额外暴露了原稿隐藏的 30 项待审与缺口；但两件事必须先补：**图件**、**设备与财务明细表**。此外 15 条待审 + 15 条缺口须逐条落地——最要紧的三条是**建筑高度**（决定耐火等级与消防水箱容积）、**总建筑面积口径**（连锁阻塞 5 条派生链）、**实验室通风取值**（决定技术方案章有没有专业深度）。

根因分四类：
  A 原件缺陷   —— 原稿本身矛盾或未给该口径（抽取反而把它抓出来了）
  B 抽取遗漏   —— 原稿有该信息，我的抽取漏了（我的责任）
  C 依据未取到 —— 需要外部规范原文，而检索摘录里被剥离/缺失
  D 判定前提缺 —— 属 A 的子类：需要外部阈值与原件取值共同判定，而原件取值有两个

方法：为每条事项定义「若原稿含有该信息，应命中的检索串」，在**原稿全文**与
**外部依据全文**中检索，据命中结果定根因。确定性、可复算。

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

WS = BUILD.parent
ROOT = WS / "SHUFE-BDC-2019-001"
ORIG = (BUILD / "doc-clean" / "大数据研究中心可研.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

                for p in (WS / "references" / "raw").glob("*.txt"))

    return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

evidence = [e for e in J(ROOT / "evidence" / "evidence.yaml") if str(e.get("id", "")).startswith("EV-")]


def hit(text, probes):
    return [p for p in probes if p in text]


# ── 每条待审事项的根因探测 ─────────────────────────────────────
CONFLICT_PROBES = {
    ("本项目", "总建筑面积"): (["2758", "18219", "18319"], "同一指标在不同章节被写成两个数（含一处笔误）"),
    ("办公用水（288 人）", "用水定额"): (["用水定额", "50", "35"], "给排水章与节能章对同一 288 人取了两个定额"),
    ("施工场界噪声", "昼间限值"): (["≤70", "70 dB"], "同一限值在两处以不同写法表述（含限定符号）"),
    ("建筑高度控制", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["建筑高度控制在60m", "层高为5米", "层高标准层"], "声明值与按层高推算值不一致"),
    ("年总耗电量", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["年总耗电量", "72"], "重算与声明存在舍入差"),
    ("基本预备费", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["基本预备费", "5%"], "重算与声明存在舍入差"),
    ("建筑安装工程费用", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["11188", "10969", "10828"], "分项之和与合计不一致"),
    ("单体工程", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["10828", "7793", "3034"], "分项之和与合计不一致"),
    ("安装工程", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["3034", "电梯工程"], "分项之和与合计不一致"),
    ("室外总体工程", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["室外总体工程", "49"], "分项之和与合计不一致（差额最大）"),
    ("工程建设其他费", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["工程建设其他费", "1171"], "分项之和与合计不一致"),
}

    "G-901": (["全校统筹"], "原稿注明「容积率、绿地率等指标全校统筹」，本项目无独立取值"),
    "G-902": (["通风柜", "实验室换气次数", "排风量"], "实验室通风专项取值原稿是否给出"),

}

CLASS = {"A": "原件缺陷（原稿本身矛盾或未给口径）", "B": "抽取遗漏（原稿有而我没抽）",
         "C": "外部依据未取到", "D": "判定前提缺失（需外部阈值＋原件取值共同判定）"}

rows = []

# 1) 冲突类
for c in conflicts:
    key = (c["subject"], c["predicate"])
    probes, why = CONFLICT_PROBES.get(key, ([], "—"))
    oh = hit(ORIG, probes)
    kind = c["type"]
    if kind == "numeric":
        cause = "A"
        note = f"原稿内含 {'、'.join(oh) if oh else '相关表述'} → 两处取值并存，**原稿本身的矛盾**"
    elif kind == "derivation":

        note = f"原稿内含 {'、'.join(oh[:2]) if oh else '分项与合计'} → 分项之和 ≠ 表列合计，**原稿算错或舍入口径不一**"

            cause = "B" if any(p in ORIG for p in ["通风柜", "实验室换气次数", "排风量"]) else "A"
        elif gid == "G-906":
            cause = "B" if ("需要系数" in ORIG and "6.5" in ORIG) else "A"
        elif gid in ("G-905",):

    elif g.get("type") == "blocked_by_conflict":
        cause = "D"
        why = "依赖存在未裁决冲突，按铁律不带着冲突往下算"
        note = "起因是「总建筑面积」冲突（本身属 A），故为连锁阻塞"
    elif g.get("type") == "basis_missing":
        cause = "C"
        why = "所需规范原文在检索摘录中被剥离，未取到"
        note = "外部依据全文命中：" + ("、".join(hit(EXT, ["5.0.1", "附表D", "附录D", "附录B"])[:3]) or "无")
    elif g.get("type") == "missing_fact":
        cause = "A"
        why = "原稿未给出该口径"
        note = "原稿未命中该口径的输入变量"
    else:
        cause = "A"
        note = "原稿显式未知"

# ── 依据清单覆盖度 ────────────────────────────────────────
cites = re.findall(r"《([^》]{4,60})》", ORIG)
uniq_cites = list(dict.fromkeys(cites))
ev_names = " ".join((e.get("doc") or "") + (e.get("quote") or "") for e in evidence)
missing_cites = [c for c in uniq_cites if c[:8] not in ev_names and c not in ev_names]

# ── 公式/计算式覆盖度 ──────────────────────────────────────
formula_lines = []
for l in ORIG.split("\n"):
    s = l.strip()
    if len(s) < 12:
        continue
    if re.search(r"(按|依据|参考).{0,12}(计算|测算|估算)|\d\s*[×*]\s*\d|K\s*=|Q\s*=|V\s*=|=\s*[\d.]|应(不小于|不大于|不超过)", s):

uniq_fl = list(dict.fromkeys(formula_lines))
rule_exprs = " ".join(r.get("expr", "") + r.get("basis", "") + r.get("label", "") for r in rules)
uncov_fl = [l for l in uniq_fl if not any(tok in rule_exprs for tok in re.findall(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]{3,8}", l)[:4])]

# ── 推理/论断覆盖度 ───────────────────────────────────────
reason_markers = ["因此", "综上", "所以", "可见", "由此", "从而", "故"]
reason_cnt = {m: ORIG.count(m) for m in reason_markers}

L = []
A = L.append
A("# 抽取完整性诊断报告")
A("")
A("> 问题：15 条待审 + 15 条缺口，是不是知识资产抽取时漏抽了 evidence / reasoning / 函数 / 公式造成的？")
A("> 方法：为每条事项定义「若原稿含该信息应命中的检索串」，在**原稿全文**与**外部依据全文**中检索，据实定根因。")
A("")
A("---")
A("")
A("## 一、直接结论")
A("")

cnt = {}
for _, _, c, _, _ in rows:
    cnt[c] = cnt.get(c, 0) + 1
A("| 根因 | 条数 | 含义 |")
A("|------|------|------|")
for k in ("A", "B", "C", "D"):
    A(f"| {k} | {cnt.get(k,0)} | {CLASS[k]} |")
A("")
A(f"共 {tot} 条。**其中属于「抽取遗漏」的 {cnt.get('B',0)} 条**：")
A("")
if cnt.get("B", 0) == 0:
    A("**没有一条是抽取遗漏造成的。** 换句话说：这 30 条不是我漏抽了 evidence/reasoning/函数/公式，"
      "而是**原稿本身就有这些问题**——抽取恰恰是把它们找出来的过程。")
else:
    A(f"有 {cnt.get('B',0)} 条需我补抽，逐条见下表。")
A("")
A("---")
A("")
A("## 二、逐条根因")
A("")
A("| 类别 | 事项 | 根因 | 为什么 | 原稿检索结果 |")

The user asks a sharp question: are the 15 待审 + 15 缺口 caused by me **omitting evidence / reasoning / functions / formulas** during knowledge asset extraction?

I need to answer this honestly and diagnostically. Let me actually diagnose each of the 30 items and classify the ROOT CAUSE:

Categories of root cause:
(A) **原件本身缺陷**（原报告内部矛盾/漏给口径）——不是我的抽取遗漏，抽取反而把它抓出来了
(B) **我的抽取遗漏**——原报告有，我没抽
(C) **外部依据未取到**——依据文件问题（表格被剥离）
(D) **判定所需前提缺失**——属于原件未给（同 A 但更细）

So the key diagnostic question: for each of the 30 items, is the information present in the ORIGINAL document (and thus extractable), or is it genuinely absent?

I can check this deterministically:
- For each gap/conflict, search the original text for the needed information (e.g., 实验室通风柜台数 — search 原稿 for 通风柜/换气次数).
- If found → my omission (B). If not found → original defect (A).

Let me build a diagnostic script that:
1. Lists all 15 conflicts + 15 gaps
2. For each, defines a probe (keywords that would contain the missing info)
3. Searches the original report + external docs
4. Reports: 原件有→抽取遗漏(B) / 原件无→原件缺陷(A) / 依据未取到(C)

Key probes:
- G-902 实验室通风: 原稿搜 "通风柜" → likely absent. Let me verify. Also "换气次数" appears (表6-8 for 卫生间/电梯机房/水泵房). So 实验室换气次数 absent → A.

Hmm, 18319×70 = 1282 kW ≠ 952. So there's an inconsistency: either the area base is smaller or a 需要系数 was applied. The original may have a 需用系数 not extracted? Let me search for 需要系数 in 强电章. I extracted 需要系数 for 科研用房 (0.8) from 表7-2 (节能章) — but 强电章 6.5.1 might have its own. Let me check the original 6.5.1 for any 系数.

- G-905 变压器容量匹配口径: 原稿 has 952kW and 2×2000kVA; 功率因数/需要系数 absent → A.
- G-904 国拨资金批复: absent from 原稿 (附件清单 says 项目资金筹措方案说明; no 批复) → A
- G-903 拆除手续: 原稿明说"正同步办理中" + 附件标注待补充 → A (原件自述)
- G-907 竣工财务决算批准文号: 原稿说"报主管部门批准" 无文号 → A
- G-901 容积率/绿地率: 原稿注"全校统筹" → A
- Conflicts:
  - 总建筑面积 18319/18219 → 原件笔误 (A)

  - derivation diffs (8处) → 原件算错/舍入 (A)
  - spec_version (4处) → 原件版本并存 (A) — but wait: are these MY extraction errors? E.g., 建筑照明设计标准 GB50034-2004 in 节能章 vs 2013 in 强电章 — I extracted both from the document; the document genuinely contains both. → A
  - spec_naming 建标191 → A
- 建筑高度 60m/49m → 原件内部不一致 (A). BUT: is the 60m real? Let me verify from the original text: "建筑高度控制在60m" — hmm, could this be a **misreading** by my extraction? Let me check the original context. If the original said "建筑高度控制在60m" then it's the doc. Let me verify the raw text.

Critical additional angle the user implies: **am I missing functions/formulas?** My extraction captured 35 rules. The original may contain formulas I didn't extract (e.g., 负荷计算式、水箱容积计算、喷淋流量计算、风量计算). Let me search the original for calculation-looking content: "计算公式", "按下式", "=", "K=", "Q=", "按...计算".

{"content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""抽取完整性诊断：15 条待审 + 15 条缺口 + 依据/公式/推理覆盖，逐条定根因。

根因分四类：
  A 原件缺陷   —— 原稿本身矛盾或未给该口径（抽取反而把它抓出来了）
  B 抽取遗漏   —— 原稿有该信息，我的抽取漏了（我的责任）
  C 依据未取到 —— 需要外部规范原文，而检索摘录里被剥离/缺失
  D 判定前提缺 —— 属 A 的子类：需要外部阈值与原件取值共同判定，而原件取值有两个

方法：为每条事项定义「若原稿含有该信息，应命中的检索串」，在**原稿全文**与
**外部依据全文**中检索，据命中结果定根因。确定性、可复算。
"""
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

BUILD = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WS = BUILD.parent
ROOT = WS / "SHUFE-BDC-2019-001"
ORIG = (BUILD / "doc-clean" / "大数据研究中心可研.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
EXT = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
                for p in (WS / "references" / "raw").glob("*.txt"))


def J(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


conflicts = J(ROOT / "quality" / "conflicts.yaml")
gaps = J(ROOT / "quality" / "gaps.yaml")
rules = J(ROOT / "graph" / "rules.yaml")
claims = J(ROOT / "graph" / "claims.yaml")
evidence = [e for e in J(ROOT / "evidence" / "evidence.yaml") if str(e.get("id", "")).startswith("EV-")]


def hit(text, probes):
    return [p for p in probes if p in text]


# ── 每条待审事项的根因探测 ─────────────────────────────────────
CONFLICT_PROBES = {
    ("本项目", "总建筑面积"): (["2758", "18219", "18319"], "同一指标在不同章节被写成两个数（含一处笔误）"),
    ("办公用水（288 人）", "用水定额"): (["用水定额", "50", "35"], "给排水章与节能章对同一 288 人取了两个定额"),
    ("施工场界噪声", "昼间限值"): (["≤70", "70 dB"], "同一限值在两处以不同写法表述（含限定符号）"),
    ("建筑高度控制", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["建筑高度控制在60m", "层高为5米", "层高标准层"], "声明值与按层高推算值不一致"),
    ("年总耗电量", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["年总耗电量", "72"], "重算与声明存在舍入差"),
    ("基本预备费", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["基本预备费", "5%"], "重算与声明存在舍入差"),
    ("建筑安装工程费用", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["11188", "10969", "10828"], "分项之和与合计不一致"),
    ("单体工程", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["10828", "7793", "3034"], "分项之和与合计不一致"),
    ("安装工程", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["3034", "电梯工程"], "分项之和与合计不一致"),
    ("室外总体工程", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["室外总体工程", "49"], "分项之和与合计不一致（差额最大）"),
    ("工程建设其他费", "派生值 vs 原文值"): (["工程建设其他费", "1171"], "分项之和与合计不一致"),
}

# ── 每条缺口的根因探测 ────────────────────────────────────────
GAP_PROBES = {
    "G-901": (["全校统筹"], "原稿注明「容积率、绿地率等指标全校统筹」，本项目无独立取值"),
    "G-902": (["通风柜", "实验室换气次数", "排风量"], "实验室通风专项取值原稿是否给出"),
    "G-903": (["拆除手续正同步进行办理中", "待补充"], "原稿自述手续在办理中"),
    "G-904": (["批复"], "国拨资金批复文件是否在附件中出现"),
    "G-905": (["功率因数", "需要系数"], "变压器容量匹配所需口径是否给出"),
    "G-906": (["总计算负荷", "45W", "25W"], "负荷估算所用面积基数是否给出"),
    "G-907": (["批准"], "竣工财务决算批准文号是否给出"),
}

CLASS = {"A": "原件缺陷（原稿本身矛盾或未给口径）", "B": "抽取遗漏（原稿有而我没抽）",
         "C": "外部依据未取到", "D": "判定前提缺失（需外部阈值＋原件取值共同判定）"}

rows = []

# 1) 冲突类
for c in conflicts:
    key = (c["subject"], c["predicate"])
    probes, why = CONFLICT_PROBES.get(key, ([], "—"))
    oh = hit(ORIG, probes)
    kind = c["type"]
    if kind == "numeric":
        cause = "A"
        note = f"原稿内含 {'、'.join(oh) if oh else '相关表述'} → 两处取值并存，**原稿本身的矛盾**"
    elif kind == "derivation":
        cause = "A"
        note = f"原稿内含 {'、'.join(oh[:2]) if oh else '分项与合计'} → 分项之和 ≠ 表列合计，**原稿算错或舍入口径不一**"
    else:  # spec_version / spec_naming
        cause = "A"
        note = "原稿同一规范出现多个版本号/名称 → **原稿引用问题**，非抽取问题"
    rows.append(("待审", c["subject"] + "·" + c["predicate"], cause, why, note))

# 2) 缺口类
for g in gaps:
    gid = g["id"]
    if gid in GAP_PROBES:
        probes, why = GAP_PROBES[gid]
        oh = hit(ORIG, probes)
        if gid == "G-902":
            cause = "B" if any(p in ORIG for p in ["通风柜", "实验室换气次数", "排风量"]) else "A"
        elif gid == "G-906":
            cause = "B" if ("需要系数" in ORIG and "6.5" in ORIG) else "A"
        elif gid in ("G-905",):
            cause = "B" if "功率因数" in ORIG else "A"
        else:
            cause = "A"
        note = f"原稿命中 {'、'.join(oh) if oh else '无（即原稿确未给出）'}"
    elif g.get("type") == "blocked_by_conflict":
        cause = "D"
        why = "依赖存在未裁决冲突，按铁律不带着冲突往下算"
        note = "起因是「总建筑面积」冲突（本身属 A），故为连锁阻塞"
    elif g.get("type") == "basis_missing":
        cause = "C"
        why = "所需规范原文在检索摘录中被剥离，未取到"
        note = "外部依据全文命中：" + ("、".join(hit(EXT, ["5.0.1", "附表D", "附录D", "附录B"])[:3]) or "无")
    elif g.get("type") == "missing_fact":
        cause = "A"
        why = "原稿未给出该口径"
        note = "原稿未命中该口径的输入变量"
    else:
        cause = "A"
        note = "原稿显式未知"
    rows.append(("缺口", g.get("subject") or g.get("label") or g.get("rule") or gid, cause, why, note))

# ── 依据清单覆盖度 ────────────────────────────────────────

import json, re
from pathlib import Path
BUILD = Path("build"); ROOT = Path("SHUFE-BDC-2019-001")
ORIG = (BUILD/"doc-clean"/"大数据研究中心可研.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
rules = json.loads((ROOT/"graph/rules.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ev = [e for e in json.loads((ROOT/"evidence/evidence.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if str(e.get("id","")).startswith("EV-")]
ev_names = " ".join((e.get("doc") or "")+(e.get("quote") or "") for e in ev)
cites = list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"《([^》]{4,60})》", ORIG)))
un = [c for c in cites if c[:8] not in ev_names and c not in ev_names]

# 分类：依据类 vs 文献类
BIAO = re.compile(r"标准|规范|规程|通则|办法|规定|通知|规划|纲要|条例|法$|决定|意见|定额|图集|规则|指南|方案|指标|措施|通则|GB|DGJ|JGJ")
LIT = re.compile(r"Journal|Annals|学报|杂志|世界|Econometrica|JASA|Statistical|Review|科学$|研究$|学报|出版社")
bi, lit, other = [], [], []
for c in un:
    (bi if BIAO.search(c) else (lit if LIT.search(c) else other)).append(c)
print("未登记引用分类：依据类", len(bi), "| 文献类", len(lit), "| 其他", len(other))
print("\n依据类未登记（应补）:")
for c in bi: print("  -", c)
print("\n其他未登记:")
for c in other[:20]: print("  -", c)

# 计算语句未覆盖：实际内容
fl = []
for l in ORIG.split("\n"):
    s = l.strip()
    if len(s) < 12: continue
    if re.search(r"(按|依据|参考).{0,12}(计算|测算|估算)|\d\s*[×*]\s*\d|K\s*=|Q\s*=|V\s*=|=\s*[\d.]|应(不小于|不大于|不超过)", s):
        fl.append(s)
fl = list(dict.fromkeys(fl))
rexpr = " ".join(r.get("expr","")+r.get("basis","")+r.get("label","") for r in rules)
unc = [l for l in fl if not any(tok in rexpr for tok in re.findall(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]{3,8}", l)[:4])]
print(f"\n计算类语句 {len(fl)} 条，未规则化 {len(unc)} 条，逐条：")
for l in unc: print("  ·", l[:110])
PYEOF", "description": "Classify uncovered citations and formula lines"}

Now I have real numbers, and they reveal **my own omissions**:

- 根因分布：原件缺陷 21、**抽取遗漏 2**、外部依据未取到 2、判定前提缺失 5
- **依据覆盖：原稿 154 处唯一引用，我只登记了 127 条证据，87 个引用未对应到证据条目！** — that IS a real extraction gap. Though many are journal names (Annals of Statistics, JASA, 管理世界) and 参考文献, not 依据. Still, some are real 依据 (关于公布世界一流大学和一流学科建设高校及建设学科名单的通知).
- **公式：25 条计算类语句，22 条未与规则对应！** — that's a big gap. Let me look at what those are. Many may be non-formula (e.g., "按规范要求设置" lines) because my regex was loose. Let me inspect.

So the honest answer is: MOSTLY not my omission (21+5=26 of 30 are original defects/conflict-cascade), but there ARE 2 items truly my omission, plus two weaker areas (依据引用未逐一登记、计算式未全部规则化) that the diagnostic surfaced.

Let me look at:
1. The 2 "抽取遗漏" items — which gaps are B?
2. The 22 uncovered formula lines — what are they really?
3. The 87 uncovered citations — how many are actual 依据 vs 期刊/文献?

Let me refine the diagnostic to be accurate rather than alarming:
- Filter citations: distinguish 依据类（规范/政策/文件，含文号或"通知/办法/规定/标准/规范/规划/纲要"） vs 参考文献类（期刊/论文）
- Inspect uncovered formula lines

Let me print them to judge.
诊断给出了**对我自己不利的数据**：87 个引用未对应证据、22 条计算语句未规则化。我得看清这些到底是什么，而不是笼统认账或笼统否认。

This is extremely informative. The honest answer:

**The diagnostic reveals a REAL and significant extraction gap of mine:**

**依据清单（evidence）—— 61 条依据类引用未登记为证据！** These are the per-chapter 设计依据/编制依据/节能依据/环评依据/劳动安全依据/招投标依据 lists. I only extracted the ones I "read closely" (about 30 in P4a/P4b/P5) and the 编制依据 in P1. But each chapter has a 依据清单 with 10-20 规范，and I did NOT systematically extract them all.

Wait — did I? Let me check: in P4a I extracted 8 evidence items for 6.1 设计依据 (EV-规范-建筑-01..08). But the original 6.1 设计依据 has MORE (the 结构设计依据 list has ~15 规范; I extracted only 4: EV-规范-结构-01..04). And 6.4 给排水依据 has ~10; I extracted 4. Etc.

So: **YES, I under-extracted the 依据清单 substantially.** 61 out of 154 unique citations have no evidence entry.

**公式/参数 —— 22 条未规则化**, but looking at them: most are **设备参数（Q/H/N/V 等铭牌参数）** and 表内技术参数, not "计算公式". E.g., "Q=12m3/h H=75m N=5.5Kw" is a pump spec, not a computable rule. So my formula-coverage metric was misleading. Of the 22:
- 2 are genuine rules I DID capture but my keyword matching missed: 未预见10%计算（R-最高日用水量 includes it）and 基本预备费5%（R-基本预备费). So those are false negatives of my diagnostic.
- 19 are 设备铭牌参数（泵组 Q/H/N、水箱 V、风机风量/全压/功率）→ these are 设备选型参数, not report-level formulas. Should be modeled as **设备节点的属性**, and indeed I extracted only a few device params (多联机). So there IS a gap: **设备参数未系统抽取**（表6-4 主要设备材料表、表6-11 主要设备表）。
- 1 is 空调用电按45/25W估算 + 总计算负荷952KW — I DID extract these as facts, and created R-总计算负荷 (which is unresolved due to missing area base). Not an omission.

So the honest classification of the formula gap:
- 设备铭牌参数类 ~19 条 → **我确实没系统抽**（只抽了多联机与部分风机）→ 属 B（抽取遗漏），但**不影响本报告的任何派生量**（设备参数不参与项目级计算，只影响设备表）。
- 2 条是我已抽但被诊断误判 → 非遗漏。
- 1 条是有意留白（面积基数未给）→ A。

And the reference-type (文献/论文) ones — 9 文献类 + 17 其他（图集名、教材名、图名）→ 属参考文献与图集，非依据，可不必登记为 evidence（但可作 reference 节点）。

Now, what does this mean for the THREE key items the user asked about?

**② 设备与技术参数未系统抽取**
- 22 条未规则化的计算类语句中，**19 条是设备铭牌参数**（泵组 Q/H/N、水箱 V、风机风量/全压/功率、IPLV）
- 这些**不参与任何项目级派生量**（只进设备表），所以不会算错数；但直接导致**还原稿无法重出表6-4 主要设备材料表、表6-11 主要设备表**——正是评估报告里数字 token 缺失的主因

诊断过程中我自己纠正了**三次误判**（把「功率因数」「需要系数」在别处的出现当成漏抽；原稿正文标题不带编号导致探针区间为空），最终 B=0 是收紧探针后的结果，不是放宽标准。

1. 补抽 61 条依据类引用为证据条目，逐条标注 名称/编号/版本/效力状态（待核）
2. 补抽表6-4、表6-11 设备铭牌参数为设备节点，使还原稿能重出这两张明细表

要我接着做 1–4 吗？这一步会把「3 条不合规」的真实规模查出来。

content.text: 你反思：是抽取的问题，还是装配的问题？如何解决？需要修改skill吗？

The user asks a reflective question: is the problem in 抽取 (extraction) or 装配 (assembly)? How to solve? Does the skill need modification?

I should do a genuine, structured reflection — not just agree. Let me think carefully and honestly about the architecture.

Let me first be precise about what "问题" we're reflecting on. From the last two turns, the identified issues are:

1. **61 条依据类引用未登记为证据** → coverage gap
2. **19 条设备铭牌参数未抽取** → detail-table gap
3. **依据复核只覆盖 22 条 Mandate（来自 20 份外部检索文件）** → scope gap
4. Earlier: 还原稿评估发现的结论章不复述、选址章漏气候参数 → **装配层遗漏**（这不是抽取问题！图里有节点，是我的散文没引用）
5. Earlier: 15+15 待审/缺口 → 原件缺陷（不是抽取也不是装配）

So the honest diagnostic: there are THREE distinct failure classes, and they live in different layers:

| 现象 | 层 | 性质 |
|---|---|---|
| 结论章不复述关键数、选址章漏气候参数 | **装配**（我的散文没引用已有节点） | 装配遗漏 |
| 61 条依据未登记、19 条设备参数未抽 | **抽取**（原稿有，我没抽） | 抽取遗漏 |
| 依据复核只覆盖 22 条 | **抽取 + 方法**（没有"依据清单必须逐条登记"这道工序） | 工序缺失 |
| 15+15 待审/缺口 | 原件 | 非缺陷，是检出 |

So the answer is: **两者都有，但根因不同，且主要是"工序/校验缺失"，不是"能力缺失"。**

Let me be more rigorous. Let me actually measure: which of the gaps are extraction vs assembly? I can compute:
- **装配遗漏**: 图里有节点（或证据）但还原稿/E 评估显示该类内容缺失 → e.g. 结论章 (nodes existed but not referenced), 气候参数 (nodes existed), 设备参数 (nodes did NOT exist → extraction), 依据 (evidence did not exist → extraction)

So: 
- 结论章不复述 = 装配遗漏（节点在，没引用）
- 选址气候参数 = 装配遗漏（节点在，没引用）
- 设备明细表 = 抽取遗漏（节点不在）
- 61 条依据 = 抽取遗漏（证据不在）
- 依据复核覆盖面 = 抽取遗漏 + 缺少"逐条核时效"工序

I can **measure** this: compute, for each fact node in the graph, whether it appears in the 还原稿. Nodes not appearing = 装配遗漏 candidates. That's a precise, computable metric! Let me do that.

That's the key insight to answer properly: **I can distinguish extraction gaps from assembly gaps by checking coverage the other way** — not "原稿→图谱"(extraction recall) but "图谱→成稿"(assembly recall).

Two-directional coverage:
- **抽取召回率** = 图谱覆盖原稿的比例（原稿有→图谱有没有）

The user asks a reflective question: is the problem in 抽取 (extraction) or 装配 (assembly)? How to solve? Does the skill need modification?

I should do a genuine, structured reflection — not just agree. Let me think carefully and honestly about the architecture.

Let me first be precise about what "问题" we're reflecting on. From the last two turns, the identified issues are:

1. **61 条依据类引用未登记为证据** → coverage gap
2. **19 条设备铭牌参数未抽取** → detail-table gap
3. **依据复核只覆盖 22 条 Mandate（来自 20 份外部检索文件）** → scope gap
4. Earlier: 还原稿评估发现的结论章不复述、选址章漏气候参数 → **装配层遗漏**（这不是抽取问题！图里有节点，是我的散文没引用）
5. Earlier: 15+15 待审/缺口 → 原件缺陷（不是抽取也不是装配）

So the honest diagnostic: there are THREE distinct failure classes, and they live in different layers:

| 现象 | 层 | 性质 |
|---|---|---|
| 结论章不复述关键数、选址章漏气候参数 | **装配**（我的散文没引用已有节点） | 装配遗漏 |
| 61 条依据未登记、19 条设备参数未抽 | **抽取**（原稿有，我没抽） | 抽取遗漏 |
| 依据复核只覆盖 22 条 | **抽取 + 方法**（没有"依据清单必须逐条登记"这道工序） | 工序缺失 |
| 15+15 待审/缺口 | 原件 | 非缺陷，是检出 |

So the answer is: **两者都有，但根因不同，且主要是"工序/校验缺失"，不是"能力缺失"。**

Let me be more rigorous. Let me actually measure: which of the gaps are extraction vs assembly? I can compute:
- **装配遗漏**: 图里有节点（或证据）但还原稿/E 评估显示该类内容缺失 → e.g. 结论章 (nodes existed but not referenced), 气候参数 (nodes existed), 设备参数 (nodes did NOT exist → extraction), 依据 (evidence did not exist → extraction)

So: 
- 结论章不复述 = 装配遗漏（节点在，没引用）
- 选址气候参数 = 装配遗漏（节点在，没引用）
- 设备明细表 = 抽取遗漏（节点不在）
- 61 条依据 = 抽取遗漏（证据不在）
- 依据复核覆盖面 = 抽取遗漏 + 缺少"逐条核时效"工序

I can **measure** this: compute, for each fact node in the graph, whether it appears in the 还原稿. Nodes not appearing = 装配遗漏 candidates. That's a precise, computable metric! Let me do that.

That's the key insight to answer properly: **I can distinguish extraction gaps from assembly gaps by checking coverage the other way** — not "原稿→图谱"(extraction recall) but "图谱→成稿"(assembly recall).

Two-directional coverage:
- **抽取召回率** = 图谱覆盖原稿的比例（原稿有→图谱有没有）
- **装配召回率** = 成稿覆盖图谱的比例（图谱有→成稿有没有）

Both are computable. That's the right framework to answer the question. Let me compute both.

Let me build the measurement:
1. **装配召回率**: for each of 343 unique nodes, is its value (or the node reference) present in 还原稿? Use value+subject matching. Compute per chapter and overall.
2. **抽取召回率**: from the diagnostic: 依据 61/154 missing → but the right denominator is "应当登记的依据类引用" = 61+ (already 127 registered)... hmm, 154 unique citations, 127 evidence entries but not 1:1. Let me compute: 依据类引用 (BIAO-matching) unique = N; how many have an evidence entry? Let me compute properly.
   Also 数字/事实: from 原稿's numeric content — I can't easily compute "all facts" recall. But 4-gram coverage 32% suggests prose recall is low (by design, rewriting). Better: for 原稿 numeric tokens (502 unique), how many are in 图? Let me compute: 原稿数字 vs 节点值集合.

Let me compute both directions and then give the layer diagnosis + solution + whether the skill needs changes.

Then the third part: **需要修改 skill 吗？**

My answer should be: 需要，但不是把 skill 写得更长，而是补**三道可机检的工序**（因为诊断表明缺的是"工序/门禁"，不是"知识"）：
1. **依据清单逐条登记**（extraction gate）: 原稿《》引用必须逐条产出 evidence 条目，不得只抽"我读到的那些"，否则 QG1 不通过。
2. **反方向覆盖校验**（assembly gate）: 图谱节点 → 成稿的引用覆盖率必须 ≥ 阈值，未引用节点要显式报告（是"不需要"还是"漏了"）。
3. **时效核查全覆盖**（compliance gate）: 报告引用的每条标准都要有时效状态；没有外部原文的标"未核实"而不是跳过。

And these should be added to:
- knowledge-processing skill（抽取侧的工序：依据清单逐条登记 + 台账）
- graph-deductive-writing-skill（装配侧的工序：反向覆盖校验）
- 或者更准确：把这三道做成**工具层可机检的门禁**（因为 skill 是自然语言指令，靠自觉；门禁是代码，靠执行）

That's the key architectural point: **我的失败不在"知不知道要抽全"，而在"没有东西强制我抽全"。** 解决方式是把"抽全"变成可机检的门禁，而不是写成更长的 skill 提示。

Let me measure first, then write the reflection.

Let me build a22_layer_diag.py:
1. 装配召回率: nodes → 还原稿 coverage (by value presence in the report text, per chapter)
2. 抽取召回率: 原稿数字/依据 → 图谱 coverage
3. 分层归因表
4. Output 交付物/报告/抽取vs装配归因报告.md

Let me implement.

For 装配召回率: for each unique node, check if str(value) appears in the 还原稿 (normalized). Careful: short values like "1" or "3" will spuriously match. Let me require: value length ≥ 3 OR (subject+predicate match). Better: check if the node's value appears AND (for short values) its subject/predicate context. Let me use: value appears as a standalone number token in 还原稿. For values of length 1-2, treat as "不可判" and exclude from denominator.

Per chapter: node's `section` field → check in the corresponding 还原稿 chapter.

Let me implement.
这个问题值得认真回答。我先把两种遗漏**分开量化**——方向相反的两次覆盖率检查。

{"content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""抽取 vs 装配：分层归因诊断。

两个方向相反的覆盖率，分别对应两个层：

  ① 抽取召回率（原稿 → 图谱）：原稿里的东西，进了图谱没有？
     —— 漏了 = 抽取层问题
  ② 装配召回率（图谱 → 成稿）：图谱里的东西，写进成稿没有？
     —— 漏了 = 装配层问题

两个方向都不查，就分不清「是没抽到」还是「抽到了没写」。
"""
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

BUILD = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WS = BUILD.parent
ROOT = WS / "SHUFE-BDC-2019-001"
ORIG = (BUILD / "doc-clean" / "大数据研究中心可研.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
RECON = (WS / "交付物" / "报告" / "上海财经大学中山北一路校区大数据研究中心可行性研究报告（还原稿）.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
EXT = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") for p in (WS / "references" / "raw").glob("*.txt"))


def J(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


nodes = J(ROOT / "graph" / "nodes.yaml")
rules = J(ROOT / "graph" / "rules.yaml")
claims = J(ROOT / "graph" / "claims.yaml")
evidence = [e for e in J(ROOT / "evidence" / "evidence.yaml") if str(e.get("id", "")).startswith("EV-")]
conflicts = J(ROOT / "quality" / "conflicts.yaml")
gaps = J(ROOT / "quality" / "gaps.yaml")

# ---------- ② 装配召回率：图谱 → 成稿 ----------
def chapters(t):
    out, cur, buf = {}, None, []
    for l in t.split("\n"):
        m = re.match(r"^#\s+(.+?)\s*$", l)
        if m:
            if cur:
                out[cur] = "\n".join(buf)
            cur, buf = m.group(1).strip(), [l]
        else:
            buf.append(l)
    if cur:
        out[cur] = "\n".join(buf)
    return out


rc = chapters(RECON)
rc_norm = {re.sub(r"[\s　]", "", k): re.sub(r"[\s　]", "", v) for k, v in rc.items()}
rc_all = re.sub(r"[\s　]", "", RECON)


def norm(v):
    return re.sub(r"[\s　]", "", str(v))


miss_nodes, unjudgeable = [], []
for n in nodes:
    v = norm(n["value"])
    if len(v) < 3:
        unjudgeable.append(n)
        continue
    if v not in rc_all:
        miss_nodes.append(n)

uniq = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
uniq_miss = {n["id"]: n for n in miss_nodes}
asm_recall = (len(uniq) - len(uniq_miss)) / len(uniq) * 100

# 按章统计装配召回
per_ch = {}
for n in uniq.values():
    ch = n.get("section") or "（未归属）"
    per_ch.setdefault(ch, [0, 0])
    per_ch[ch][1] += 1
    if n["id"] not in uniq_miss and norm(n["value"]) in rc_norm.get(re.sub(r"[\s　]", "", ch), ""):
        per_ch[ch][0] += 1
    elif n["id"] not in uniq_miss:
        per_ch[ch][0] += 1        # 值在成稿某处出现即算引用（可能跨章引用）

# 未引用节点归因：哪些是「有意不复述」哪些是「漏了」
SKIP_OK = re.compile(r"估算金额|台数|单台制冷量|间数|单间用房标准|地址|四至|温度|湿度|粗糙度|"
                     r"竖向|土层|矿化|潜水位|单井出水|水质|干球|湿球|大气压力|系数|强度|等级|牌号")


def bucket(n):
    if SKIP_OK.search(n["predicate"]):
        return "可意省略（明细/参数类）"
    if n["status"] == "pending_review":
        return "有意并列呈现（冲突项）"
    if n["status"] == "undefined":
        return "有意留白（undefined）"
    return "**应复核：可能漏引**"


bucket_cnt = {}
for n in uniq_miss.values():
    b = bucket(n)
    bucket_cnt[b] = bucket_cnt.get(b, 0) + 1
    n["_bucket"] = b

# ---------- ① 抽取召回率：原稿 → 图谱 ----------
cites = list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"《([^》]{4,60})》", ORIG)))
_BIAO = re.compile(r"标准|规范|规程|通则|办法|规定|通知|规划|纲要|条例|法$|决定|意见|定额|图集|规则|指南|指标|措施|GB|DGJ|JGJ")
biaotype = [c for c in cites if _BIAO.search(c)]
ev_names = " ".join((e.get("doc") or "") + (e.get("quote") or "") for e in evidence)
ev_hit = [c for c in biaotype if c[:6] in ev_names or c in ev_names]
ev_miss = [c for c in biaotype if c not in ev_hit]

# 数字：原稿数字 token vs 图谱节点值
NUM = re.compile(r"\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?")
o_nums = {f"{float(m.replace(',','')):g}" for m in NUM.findall(ORIG) if m.replace(",", "").replace(".", "").isdigit()}
g_nums = {f"{float(re.sub(r'[^0-9.]','',str(n['value'])) or 0):g}" for n in nodes
          if re.match(r"^[\d,]+(\.\d+)?$", str(n["value"]).replace(",", ""))}

# 设备参数（Q/H/N/V/风量/功率）在原稿的数量 vs 图谱
DEV = re.compile(r"\bQ\s*=|风量|全压|静压|IPLV|单台泵流量")
dev_lines = [l for l in ORIG.split("\n") if DEV.search(l)]
dev_in_graph = sum(1 for n in nodes if DEV.search(n["subject"] + n["predicate"] + n["value"]))

L = []

A("# 抽取 vs 装配：分层归因报告")
A("")
A("> 同一批「内容不全」的现象，可能来自两个完全不同的层。本报告用**两个方向相反的覆盖率**把它们分开。")
A("")
A("---")
A("")
A("## 一、两个方向，两套指标")
A("")
A("```")
A("        ① 抽取召回率                     ② 装配召回率")
A("   原稿 ──────────► 图谱 ──────────► 成稿（还原稿）")
A("        漏了 = 抽取层问题              漏了 = 装配层问题")
A("```")
A("")
A("| 指标 | 算法 | 结果 |")
A("|------|------|------|")
A(f"| **② 装配召回率** | 图谱 {len(uniq)} 个唯一节点中，值出现在成稿的比例 | **{asm_recall:.1f}%**"
  f"（未出现 {len(uniq_miss)} 个，其中 {len(unjudgeable)} 个因值过短不可判，未计入分母） |")
A(f"| **① 抽取召回率·依据** | 原稿依据类引用 {len(biaotype)} 个中，已登记为证据的比例 | "
  f"**{len(ev_hit)/len(biaotype)*100:.1f}%**（未登记 {len(ev_miss)} 个） |")
A(f"| **① 抽取召回率·设备参数** | 原稿含设备参数的语句 {len(dev_lines)} 条 vs 图谱中设备参数节点 {dev_in_graph} 个 | "

A("")

A("")

A("")
A("| 归因 | 节点数 | 性质 |")
A("|------|--------|------|")
for b, c in sorted(bucket_cnt.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    A(f"| {b} | {c} | {'✅ 合理' if '应复核' not in b else '⚠️ **需人工确认**'} |")

Presented 交付物/报告/抽取vs装配归因报告.md
Presented 交付物/报告/抽取完整性诊断.md

我做了反思，但先把「猜」变成「量」——用**两个方向相反的覆盖率**把两层分开（`交付物/报告/抽取vs装配归因报告.md`）：

```
     ① 抽取召回率                    ② 装配召回率
原稿 ──────────► 图谱 ──────────► 成稿
     漏了=抽取层问题               漏了=装配层问题
```

## 量化结果

| 方向 | 指标 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| ② 装配 | 图谱 343 个唯一节点 → 成稿引用率 | **96.2%**（13 个未引用，再分：**真漏引 3 个** + 表述差异 9 个） |
| ① 抽取·依据 | 原稿依据类引用 121 个 → 已登记证据 | **55.4%**（**54 条未登记**） |
| ① 抽取·设备参数 | 原稿设备参数语句 30 条 → 图谱节点数 | **30 → 1**（几乎未抽） |

## 结论：两层都有，但主次分明

**主要是抽取层，而且不是能力问题，是「工序缺失」。**

- 依据清单：我**没有「逐条核销该章依据清单」这个动作**——只抽了我认为重要的，剩下 54 条从视野里消失了，而且**没有任何东西提醒我**。这件事是可判定的（该章出现的每个《》都应有 evidence 条目）。
- 设备参数：我**主动判定**「设备选型属设计单位范围，不必抽」。这个判断对派生量无影响，但使成稿无法重出设备明细表——是**策略选择**，不是漏。

**装配层也有小缺口，而且我在自己写的规则上犯了错。**

真漏引只有 3 个，但共性很刺眼：**全是表格里的数字被我的散文概括掉了**——

| 漏引节点 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 上海财经大学·双证硕士 | 5631 |
| 统计与管理学院·2018年合同经费 | 428 |
| 本项目·基本雪压 | 0.20 |

我在自己写的 `章节提示词索引.md` 的 `must_not` 里明确禁止过：「写『设置机械通风系统』『按现行规范设置』这类句子，每一句都对，每一句都没说本项目」——**结果我自己在成稿里写了「按规定设置」「保持规定间距」，把数字概括掉了。** 而且没有东西拦我。

另有「结论章一个数都没有」（我误把「不引入新数」执行成「不放任何数」）、「选址章漏气候参数」——同类。

**而 15+15 待审/缺口既不是抽取也不是装配的问题**，是原稿本身的缺陷（23 条原件缺陷 + 2 条依据未取到 + 5 条冲突连锁）。这类**不能「修复」，只能由客户裁决**。

## 怎么解决：三道可机检的门禁

| 门禁 | 规则 | 加在哪 | 现状会不会拦住我 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **G1 依据清单逐条核销** | 该章正文出现的每个《…》必须有 evidence 条目，否则该章抽取不通过 | 工序 4 与 6 之间 | **会**（54 条非空即阻塞） |
| **G2 节点引用覆盖核销** | `status=defined` 且非明细类的节点，成稿引用率 ≥ 阈值；未引用须逐条给理由（可省略／有意留白／跨章已引） | 写作返回契约 | **会**（3 个真漏引会被点名） |
| **G3 引用标准时效三查** | 每条被引用标准须有 名称/编号/版本/效力状态；无外部原文标「未核实」，不得留空跳过 | 工序 6 质量登记 | **会**（这最该先补——「3 条不合规」是下限不是全量） |

## 需要改 skill 吗：需要，但不是加长提示词

| 该改什么 | 落点 |
|---|---|
| 依据清单逐条核销 | `knowledge-processing` skill 工序 4 后插一道**引用核销**检查 |
| 节点引用覆盖核销 | `graph-deductive-writing-skill` 的**返回契约**增加 `unreferenced_nodes: [{node_id, reason}]` |
| 时效三查全覆盖 | `knowledge-processing` 工序 6：从「有外部文件才查」改为「**全部引用逐一登记状态**」 |
| 上述实现 | `kp_toolkit` 加 `audit_citations` / `audit_node_usage`，纳入 `gate_check`，**由编排器判定，不由写作 Agent 自判** |

**为什么是加门禁而不是加提示词**：这三件事都不是「我不知道要做」。问题在于——**自然语言指令只能靠自觉执行，而可机检的判据不能在失败时假装通过**。这次的诊断本身就是证据：我自己写的 skill 里没有「逐条核销依据清单」这条，于是我按重要性抽了 67 条，剩下 54 条安静地消失了。把规则写得更长不会改变这一点；**让它变成跑不过就是跑不过的检查，才会改变。**

## 一句话

| 问题 | 答案 |
|---|---|
| 是抽取还是装配？ | **两者都有**：依据清单（54 条）与设备参数（29 条）属**抽取**；3 个数字被概括掉属**装配** |
| 是能力问题吗？ | **不是**。都是「知道要做但没人核销」——缺的是门禁，不是知识 |
| 15+15 呢？ | 两者都不是，是原稿缺陷被检出，只能由客户裁决 |
| 要改 skill 吗？ | **要**，但改法是加**可机检的完成判据**，不是加更多说明文字 |

要不要我现在就把 G1/G2/G3 实现成可调用函数并接进 `gate_check`，然后拿本项目跑一遍——那样能直接告出「不合规」的真实规模？

The user asks: "还是需要修正verify的机制？" — Is it (actually) the **verify mechanism** that needs fixing?

This is a sharp escalation of the diagnosis. Let me think honestly:

My previous answer proposed three "gate" checks G1/G2/G3. The user is now pointing at the deeper layer: **the verify mechanism itself**.

What IS my verify mechanism currently? Let me enumerate honestly:

1. `corpus_pipeline/ontology.validate_extraction` — validates LLM extraction units (schema: chunk_id present, facts have subject/value, claim_type/status in enums, relation type in TEN_RELATIONS). **What it does NOT check**: whether the extraction is COMPLETE. It's a *shape* validator, not a *coverage* validator. If I extract 1 fact out of 100, it passes happily.

2. `stage_6_quality` — dangling evidence refs, conflicts, gaps → gate PASS/REVIEW.

3. `quality_gates.py` QG1/QG2/QG3 — QG1 (version+fingerprint+anchors), QG2 (claim types + relation from/to + evidence source), QG3 (16 domains have assembly_method + no cycles).

4. My own `s5_replay` derivation checks — numeric recomputation.

5. `gate_check_draft` (orchestrator) — literal numbers, must_cover keywords, undefined usage in a draft.

6. My ad-hoc audits this session: remap validation, citation coverage, node usage coverage, timeliness.

So the honest structural diagnosis:

**All existing verify mechanisms check "correctness of what's there", none check "completeness of what should be there".**

That's the root defect. Specifically:
- `validate_extraction` iterates over `ext.get("facts", [])` — it can only see what I already extracted. **By construction it can never detect a missing fact.** This is the key insight: **a validator that iterates over the artifact cannot detect omission from the source.**
- Coverage can only be checked by **cross-referencing against an independent index of the source**: e.g., 原稿的《》全集、原稿的表格全集、原稿的数字全集、原稿的章节全集。
- My session did exactly that ad-hoc (citations 154 vs 67; device params 30 vs 1; nodes 343 vs 13; sections 135 vs 108). But these were **one-off scripts written after the fact**, not part of the pipeline. And crucially: **they were written only because the user asked.**

So yes — the answer is: **是的，根因在 verify 机制，而且是机制的结构性缺陷**：
1. **验证方向错了**：现有 validator 都是「产物内部自洽性」检查（artifact-internal），缺的是「产物 vs 源」的**完备性**检查（artifact-vs-source closure）。
2. **没有源侧索引**（source-side index）：要查完备性，必须先把源「可枚举」——原稿引用了哪些标准、有哪些表、有哪些数字、有哪些章节。这个索引我没有建。有了它，缺失就是集合差，不需要"注意"。
3. **验证对象错了**：验证的是「抽出来的东西对不对」，而不是「该抽的都抽了没有」。
4. **无独立第二遍**：所有验证都是我自己在同一个上下文中做的——同一双眼睛看两遍，看不见自己的盲区。**verify 必须由不同于 producer 的通道执行**（要么是独立进程/独立索引，要么是另一个 agent）。
5. **门禁是"事后审计"而非"事前阻塞"**：我这次的检查全是事后写的脚本；机制里没有把它们接进流程。

So the fix: 
**把 verify 从「自洽性校验」升级为「闭环校验（closure verification）」**，核心是**建源侧索引（source-side ledger）**，然后验证 = 集合差。

Concretely:
- `source_ledger.json`: 由确定性工具从原稿生成
  - citations[]: 全部《》引用 + 位置
  - tables[]: 全部表格 + 表头 + 位置
  - numbers[]: 全部数值 token + 位置（去重后按章）
  - headings[]: 全部标题层级
  - images[]: 全部图注
  - formulas_hint[]: 含计算语气的语句
- 抽取后校验：`ledger.xxx - extracted.xxx` 必须为空或落在显式豁免清单
- 装配后校验：`graph.nodes - draft.referenced` 必须为空或落在显式豁免清单
- 时效校验：`ledger.citations` 每条必须有 status，未核实≠通过

And importantly: **verify 必须可判定、可失败、且失败即阻塞**。

Also a deeper point: **verify 的独立性**。My validators are in the same codebase and same session as the producer. The strongest form: verify 由**另一个角色**执行（或至少在独立进程中、基于独立索引），并且 verify 的输出是**结构化的待核销清单**，不是"看起来没问题"。

Let me also be honest about a subtlety: completeness verification requires the source ledger to be built by a *different* method than the extraction, otherwise the same blind spot applies. E.g., citations ledger built by regex over the raw docx text is independent of my LLM reading. Numbers ledger by regex — independent. Tables by docx w:tbl count — independent. That's exactly what makes it a real check. My session's citations audit WAS regex-based, hence it caught the 54.

So: **the mechanism that worked (regex-based source ledger vs extracted set) is exactly what should be institutionalized.**

Now, should I also be careful: is it possible that the user's question means "your verify produced false alarms (B=0 after 3 corrections) — maybe the verify mechanism itself is buggy?" That's a fair reading too: my diagnostics had 3 false-positive corrections (功率因数/需要系数 probes, empty section range). So the verify mechanism needs: (a) closure direction, (b) source ledger, (c) independence, (d) **its own verification** (my probes were wrong 3 times — a verify layer without self-check produces false alarms; false alarms erode trust).

Let me include that: **verify 自身也要可验证** — 每个探针要有"正样本/负样本"自测（e.g., 探针必须能在原稿中命中一个已知存在的实例，否则探针无效）。That's a real engineering discipline: probe calibration.

Let me build the deliverable: a design + working implementation of the revised verify mechanism, and run it on this project to show what it catches.

Given budget, I should be efficient but concrete. Let me:
1. Write `build/v23_verify.py` implementing the closure-verify mechanism:
   - build source ledger (deterministic, regex/XML-based, independent of extraction)
   - compute the three closure checks (citations, tables, numbers/设备参数, headings)
   - compute assembly closure (nodes → draft)
   - compute timeliness closure (citation status)
   - **probe calibration self-test** (each probe must hit a known-present anchor)
   - output structured 待核销清单 + verdict
2. Write the design in `交付物/报告/verify机制修正方案.md` with the before/after comparison table.
3. Run it, report what it catches.

## Primary Request and Intent
- Original: "把这个可研报告处理为可以复用的资产域以及每个域对应的文件，打包为ZIP" — process `上海财经大学中山北一路校区大数据研究中心 可行性研究报告（修订版）.docx` into reusable asset domains, one file per domain, packaged as ZIP.
- Follow-up 1: "外部检索的文件需要与'…可行性研究报告（修订版）'联合做知识处理，因为'…'里面的技术函数，依赖关系是基于'外部检索的文件'" — external retrieval files must be processed **jointly** with the report; the report's technical functions/rules take their value-domain constraints and inference warrants from them.
- Follow-up 2: "你把'外部检索的文件需要与'…'的输入信息形成一个MD文档，便于我可以把这个文档让'推演写作专家'基于你抽取的'知识资产'+'事实输入信息'，装配之后，还原写一个报告" — produce a single MD the user can hand to the "推演写作专家" so it can assemble 知识资产 + 事实输入 and reconstruct the report.
- Follow-up 3 (two questions): "你输出的'规范依赖句子.md'是否应该是知识资产的一部分？" and "'…可行性研究报告（修订版）'对应的'每个章节的提示词'有抽取吗？"
- Follow-up 4: "下一步，我需要把'推演写作输入包.md'和'章节提示词索引.md'输入给：'推演写作专家'。但是你告诉我：把你输出的'知识资产-上财大数据研究中心可研-2019ZX054'放在哪里？也是上下文形式发给它吗？"

## Key Technical Concepts
- Role: knowledge-processing expert (沈溯源). Core doctrine: deterministic steps in code (zero LLM, reproducible); only genuinely semantic steps via LLM with JSON schema + validator + retry.
- kp toolchain at `/Users/apple/Desktop/workdsh/knowledge/knowledge-processing-expert` (`kp_toolkit`, `corpus_pipeline`, `mcp/server.py`); venv python: `/Users/apple/Desktop/workdsh/knowledge/knowledge-processing-expert/.venv/bin/python` (has pymupdf; **no python-docx**).
- 七道工序 + 30-file contract (`corpus_pipeline/spec.py` MANIFEST); manifest status machine draft→validated→published.
- 16-domain contract `corpus_pipeline.full_emit.DOMAIN_SPECS` (order: ontology, argument_chain, scenario, variable, task_dag, function, rule, invariant, skill, report_structure, report_form, prompt, quality_gate, reuse_strategy, entity_relation, cost_risk); `corpus_pipeline.dependencies.ASSET_DEPENDENCIES` (16-node dep graph, root=ontology) + `impacted_assets`/`dependents_of`/`dependency_closure`.
- TEN_RELATIONS: has_value, has_attribute, instance_of, part_of, causes, depends_on, supports, contradicts, temporal, located_in.
- claim_type ∈ (fact, hypothesis, inference, conclusion, recommendation); status ∈ (unverified, supported, contradicted, verified).

entries.name: feasibility-report-edu-research
entries.description: 编制、审校、修订【高校科研用房】类项目的可行性研究报告，一律以国家发改委发改投资规〔2023〕304号 《政府投资项目可行性研究报告编写通用大纲》为基准。适用对象：高校研究中心、研究院、重点实验室、 科研实验楼、交叉研究平台、中试基地及其配套用房。**最终交付一份 Word 文档（.docx）**，用本体图谱驱动生成：所有事实只存一份、跨章自动传播、 每条论断绑定证据、法定章节覆盖自动校验、客户改稿可反向回读。 当用户提到"科研楼可研""实验楼立项""研究中心可行性研究""科研用房建设规模论证""人均科研用房面积指标" "建标191-2018"，或上传一份科研用房类可研要写、要改、要审、要查数字前后矛盾、要按2023新大纲改口径时， 都应使用本 skill——即使用户没说"本体"或"图谱"。 不适用于：学生宿舍与食堂（用 feasibility-report-edu-student-life）、教学楼图书馆、 产业园区厂房、施工图设计、招标文件编制。

entries.name: knowledge-generalization-skill
entries.description: 从历史项目中提取可复用 Ontology、Reasoning Pattern、Claim Pattern、分析框架和规则，同时隔离项目专属事实。

entries.name: knowledge-processing
entries.description: 把文档/语料（docx/pdf/md）经七道工序处理为结构化知识图谱语料包，产出 30 个契约文件（含脱敏骨架 skeletons.jsonl）。当用户要求把稿件处理成语料包、跑「归一化→骨架→切块→本体→回放→质量→脱敏索引」七道工序流水线、产出知识图谱/脱敏骨架、或使用 kp_toolkit / corpus_pipeline / MCP 工具（5 组 65 工具）时使用。与 knowledge-processing-toolchain 的区别：本 skill 覆盖完整流水线与 30 文件产物契约，toolchain 覆盖工具+LLM 分层方法论。

entries.name: knowledge-processing-toolchain
entries.description: 以「工具 + LLM」分层模式做知识处理。确定性步骤（分句、分块、图谱编译、溯源、数字/时间冲突、schema 校验）调用 kp_toolkit 代码执行（零 LLM、可复现）；语义步骤（实体/事实/关系/Claim/证据/推理抽取、证据判断、推演写作）才调用 LLM，且必须按 schema 输出 JSON 并经 validator 校验、失败重试。当用户要求把文档/语料处理为结构化知识图谱、或要求「确定性走工具、语义走 LLM」时使用。

entries.name: math-modeling
entries.description: 当用户要求数学建模、建模竞赛、建模分析、代码求解、结果可视化或生成数学建模论文时使用。支持完整三阶段流程、单独执行任一角色，以及在关键节点使用独立 Subagent 进行阶段内质检；默认只启用质检 Subagent，用户可明确选择额外协作。

entries.name: nature-academic-search

entries.name: resanity

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: content_capabilities
tools.description: Discover implemented operations and limits. Word supports native paragraphs/headings/tables/embedded images and structured editable charts; DOCX export writes Office chart parts with embedded workbooks instead of chart pictures. Browser DOCX working-copy import is available but complex objects are not lossless. pptx-react-viewer presentations support native slides and editable charts; PPTX download is available in the right-hand editor, content_export delivers the saved PPTX through the official file card. Excel supports new live workbooks, A1 cell values/formulas, and sheet add/rename/remove; browser Univer computes formulas, Host does not. Excel formatting/charts and live XLSX import remain unavailable.

tools.name: content_edit
tools.description: Atomically commit a small streamed batch: at most 4 typed operations / 1 MiB; Word insert calls contain at most 8 top-level blocks, with a table in its own call. Each batch is visible without waiting for the whole answer. Use baseRevision from content_read and a new operationId. Retry uncertain delivery with exactly the same payload and ID. HUMAN_EDITING: user holds the editor; stop writing and wait, do not repeatedly call. A committed receipt is durable content, not an exported Office file.

operations.description: Keep streamed JSON bounded. For Word, insert no more than 8 top-level blocks per call and put a table or chart in its own call.

level.description: Required for heading (1–6); omit for paragraph.

fontFamily.description: Font family, e.g. 宋体 or Calibri; letters, Chinese, spaces and hyphens only.

depth.description: 0–5; first item depth 0, no depth jumps.

continuation.description: True for another paragraph of the existing item at this depth.

src.description: Use office-image:sourceDocumentId:blockId:hash returned by content_read to copy an image from an authorized Office document. New image: embedded PNG/JPEG data URL, up to 512 KiB. Remote URLs unsupported.

chart.description: Native editable Word chart. Supply structured data; never render a chart to PNG.

items.description: One pptx-viewer-core native slide. Use state.deck.canvas exactly; geometry x,y,width,height is top-left CSS pixels and must remain inside the canvas. textStyle.fontSize is points, not a canvas coordinate. chartData holds chartType,categories,series [{name,values}].

oneOf.description: Compatibility only: one JSON-encoded input object. Prefer the object form.

tools.name: content_export
tools.description: Export a committed PDF working copy as its actual PDF file, or HTML webpage as its actual HTML file, or Word document as real DOCX or native presentation as real PPTX, or spreadsheet as real XLSX through the official present card. Use baseRevision from content_read. Same document/revision/content has a stable path; uncertain-write retries check existing bytes and never overwrite conflicts. Uses official bash approval and requires bash/present in this Session. On delivery-only failure, check the card and retry present for the returned path. The live editor remains editable. Tables and embedded PNG/JPEG images are retained; complex Word pagination is not lossless.

baseRevision.description: Latest revision from content_read. Reuse on uncertain-write retries; rejects changed document revisions.

tools.name: content_import_pptx
tools.description: Open a real PPTX template/file as a separate editable live working copy. Read the known file path via the calling Session Harness filesystem. Preserve original package, masters, layouts, theme and media; never modify the source file. Use this instead of source=new when a customer template is required. Reuse operationId and identical file bytes on retries. Inspect imported slides before editing, retain native metadata, and never treat template sample text as report facts. Limit 8 MiB, 50 slides, 200 elements per slide.

tools.name: content_open
tools.description: Create or reopen Word, PPT, Excel, PDF or a live single-file HTML webpage. For new PDF use kind=pdf, source=new; read pages and edit one page through pdf.updatePage/insertPage/removePage. Coordinates are top-left points, A4 595.28x841.89. Text and rectangles are supported; Chinese font is bundled. Existing arbitrary PDF import/OCR/image editing is unavailable. For HTML use kind=html, source=new, then html.replaceDocument with a complete self-contained HTML string in each meaningful batch; preview opens immediately and refreshes after committed revisions. Inline scripts/styles work; external dependencies are blocked in preview. For Excel use kind=spreadsheet, source=new; returned state has sheetOrder and sheets with A1-keyed cells. For a customer PPTX template call content_import_pptx with its actual path; never substitute a blank deck. For an ordinary new PPT set input.kind=presentation, source=new, title and operationId; optional brief. Automatically opens the live right-hand editor immediately; no content_present call is needed. New documents start with one empty paragraph. Use content_edit in small meaningful batches as you write so the user sees progress in the document, rather than waiting for the whole report. Reuse operationId on retries. This is not DOCX import.

brief.description: Optional planning context; opening initializes only one title page. Add/update each slide in a separate content_edit.

tools.name: content_present
tools.description: Request this document in the calling Session right sidebar. Call once, then continue edit batches. status=requested does not claim a browser displayed it. Never switches another Session.

tools.name: content_preview_styles
tools.description: Save four PPT cover style previews in the calling Session right sidebar. This is an HTML planning preview, not a PPT export or a submitted user choice. Then use official ask_user_question with the returned A–D labels and wait. Red means four red directions, not automatically red-gold. After a choice, reopen the original presentation by documentId and apply the selected palette/layout to native slides. Reuse operationId and identical arguments on retries.

tools.name: content_read
tools.description: Read the latest committed document, revision and stable block/run IDs. Re-read after a user edit or REVISION_CONFLICT; never guess revision or text. Image src values are opaque references, not Base64; copy them exactly into content_edit for the target document; source read access is checked.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: cua_driver_native__bring_to_front
tools.description: Persistently activate an app and leave it in the foreground. Most input does not need this; use it only for a focus-proxy surface that must remain foreground across interactions. With window_id, success means the exact ordinary macOS window was independently verified as the focused window and first in WindowServer layer-0 order. Request acceptance alone is reported as a partial result, never as activation. This DOES steal foreground.

tools.name: cua_driver_native__browser_click
tools.description: Click a page element (by ref) or viewport coordinates in an exactly-bound tab. Default route is trusted hardware-like input (Input.dispatchMouseEvent), and refuses where that route cannot preserve standalone-browser background posture. input_route="dom_event" (synthetic el.click(), ref required) is used only when explicitly requested; it proves dispatch, not control activation, because trust-gated controls may ignore synthetic events. Refused for heuristic bindings.

input_route.description: "trusted" (default): Input.dispatchMouseEvent. It refuses rather than foregrounding a standalone browser. "dom_event": synthetic full-background DOM click, only when explicitly requested. Dispatch does not prove the control activated; refresh page state and verify the expected postcondition.

ref.description: Page element ref in the p<snapshot>:<index> namespace from get_browser_state. Refs are invalidated by navigation and by newer snapshots of the same tab.

session.description: For multi-call work, prefer a short public session label and repeat it on every call that accepts it. Omit it to use the authenticated transport's implicit lifecycle session. Browser targets, tabs, and refs belong to the resolved lifecycle session.

target_id.description: Opaque browser target id minted by get_browser_state (session-scoped; never a CDP id).

x.description: Viewport x (CSS px) — alternative to ref.

y.description: Viewport y (CSS px) — alternative to ref.

tools.name: cua_driver_native__browser_dialog
tools.description: Inspect or resolve a page-owned JavaScript alert, confirm, prompt, or beforeunload dialog on one exactly-bound tab. This never handles browser permission UI, extension UI, native dialogs, or file pickers. Inspect returns an opaque dialog_id; accept/dismiss require that exact current id. Resolution defaults to background delivery; Linux callers must explicitly request foreground delivery because Chromium's native modal cannot be resolved there without changing foreground posture.

delivery_mode.description: Requested foreground posture for accept/dismiss. Linux Chromium requires foreground; inspect is read-only.

dialog_id.description: Opaque current dialog generation returned by action=inspect.

prompt_text.description: Sensitive response text, valid only when accepting a prompt dialog.

session.description: For multi-call work, prefer a short public session label and repeat it on every call that accepts it. Omit it to use the authenticated transport's implicit lifecycle session. Browser targets, tabs, and refs belong to the resolved lifecycle session.

target_id.description: Opaque browser target id minted by get_browser_state (session-scoped; never a CDP id).

tools.name: cua_driver_native__browser_download
tools.description: Trigger one download through an exact live browser ref and save it inside an explicitly approved directory. Requires MCP-host destructive-tool approval, refuses ambiguous or stale capabilities, and never returns the source URL, filename, or destination path.

destination_root.description: Absolute, existing, canonical directory approved to receive the download.

ref.description: Live page ref whose activation initiates the download.

session.description: For multi-call work, prefer a short public session label and repeat it on every call that accepts it. This tool requires the label that owns its browser target, tab, and refs.

tools.name: cua_driver_native__browser_prepare
tools.description: Explicitly prepare an owned DevTools endpoint for a browser. pid is required for an existing process or existing-profile attachment, and optional only for allow_launch=true with an isolated profile. Existing endpoints are detected without side effects. Acting setup for an isolated profile follows the runtime permission mode and optional capability manifest. It requires allow_launch=true, launches a separate browser, and never copies, modifies, or terminates the requested user profile. Without pid, only a platform-attested system Chrome/Edge installation (or a root-owned package payload on Linux) is eligible; redirects and user-controlled locations fail closed. Existing-profile attachment is explicit and follows the runtime's immutable permission mode: standard requires an explicit --grant existing-profile launch grant or an embedding authorization host, bounded requires a launch-approved exact resource manifest, and unrestricted requires explicit trusted startup risk acceptance. Ordinary MCP transport approval never proves profile authorization. On proven platforms, an authorized request also permits one bounded exact-window setup: open the recognized browser product's fixed remote-debugging page, toggle its uniquely matched per-instance checkbox, prove the PID-owned loopback endpoint, and close the temporary tab. Every visible effect is reported; ambiguity is refused.

allow_launch.description: Allow a separate driver-owned isolated Chromium process to be launched (default false).

pid.description: Browser process id to prepare. Required except for a driver-owned isolated_new/isolated_named launch with allow_launch=true.

tools.name: cua_driver_native__check_permissions
tools.description:
Report TCC permission status for Accessibility and Screen Recording. By default also raises the system permission dialogs for any missing grants — Apple's request APIs are no-ops when the grant is already active, so this is safe to call repeatedly. Pass {"prompt": false} for a purely read-only status check.

Returns: `accessibility` + `screen_recording` (booleans from the TCC preflight APIs), `screen_recording_capturable` (a live ScreenCaptureKit probe when `prompt` is true; null on read-only calls), `direct_capture_status` (`ready`, `unavailable`, `timed_out`, `probe_failed`, `blocked_by_screen_recording`, or `not_checked`), `direct_capture_error` (a structured timeout/probe failure when applicable), `direct_capture_verification` (validated source, UTC time, and bundle identity from an explicit grant probe), and `source` (which TCC identity the booleans reflect: the CuaDriver daemon vs the launching terminal/IDE). macOS attributes grants to the responsible process, so a standalone call from a terminal reports the terminal's grants, not the driver's. The prompt-capable ScreenCaptureKit probe never runs when `prompt` is false. Pass `probe_direct_capture:false` with `prompt:true` to register/request only the two required TCC grants before separately explaining Tahoe's direct-capture consent.

probe_direct_capture.description: When prompting and Screen Recording is granted, also run the live ScreenCaptureKit probe that may raise Tahoe's direct-capture consent. Default true. Set false for a staged Accessibility/Screen Recording request.

prompt.description: Raise the system permission prompts for missing grants. Default false; only a trusted host setup route may set true.

tools.name: cua_driver_native__click
tools.description:
Click against a target pid. **Prefer `element_token` over pixel coordinates** — the token works on backgrounded / minimized / hidden / off-Space windows, identifies one exact snapshot element, and tells you what you're clicking via the cached element's role + label. Reach for `x, y` only when the target is a canvas / video / WebGL / custom-drawn surface that doesn't appear in the AX tree.

Two addressing modes:

- element_token, or element_index + snapshot_id (from get_window_state): AX action path. Works on backgrounded/hidden windows. No cursor move, no focus steal. The snapshot cache is scoped per (pid, window_id) and is replaced by the next snapshot of the same window — re-snapshot every turn before clicking.

- x, y (window-local screenshot pixels, top-left origin of the PNG returned by get_window_state): CGEvent path. Synthesizes mouse events and posts to pid. Use modifier for cmd/shift/option/ctrl. Needs a visible on-screen window to anchor the conversion.

button: "left" (default), "right", or "middle". Defaults to left so the field is fully back-compat — omit it and you get the legacy left-click behaviour. Pixel path: routes through the CGEvent left/right/middle mouse-button primitives. AX path: "right" maps to AXShowMenu (same surface as the dedicated `right_click` tool); "middle" has no AX equivalent and falls back to a pixel middle-click at the element's center.
action: press (default), show_menu, pick, confirm, cancel, open.
from_zoom: set true after a zoom call to auto-translate zoom-image pixel coordinates to full-window space.

action.description: AX action: press, show_menu, pick, confirm, cancel, open.

button.description: Mouse button. Default: "left" — omit for legacy left-click behaviour. Pixel path uses the matching CGEvent primitive; AX path maps "right" to AXShowMenu and falls back to a pixel middle-click at the element's center for "middle".

debug_image_out.description: Optional file path. When set on a pixel-addressed click, captures a fresh screenshot, draws a red crosshair at (x, y), and writes the PNG. Use to verify coordinate spaces. Requires window_id; incompatible with from_zoom.

delivery_mode.description: Best-effort-background ladder rung (default "background"). "background": perform the AX action or post the CGEvent without fronting. "foreground": briefly front the window, act, let transient UI settle, then restore the prior frontmost app. Requires window_id. Modified clicks require "foreground" so macOS observes physical modifier-key state. A generic click has no independent postcondition read-back, except selection of list-like AX rows whose AXSelected state can be confirmed; otherwise confirm the effect from a fresh state snapshot. Use the agent loop: background AX (element_index) → snapshot → background pixel (x/y) → snapshot → delivery_mode:"foreground".

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. If element_index, snapshot_id, or window_id are also supplied they must agree. Returns an explicit stale error once a newer snapshot supersedes it.
